title: RuVocal front-door chat UI (human surface, adopt-and-extend)
objective: ADR-0001 §11/§12/R14: RuVocal (~/Desktop/meta/RuVector/ui/ruvocal) is an unmodified HuggingFace Chat-UI fork (SvelteKit) with an mcp-bridge/ subpackage; nothing in it consumes loop events yet. Adopt-and-extend it as the human chat front door: vibe request in -> dispatch via the MCP seam (HFTASK-0019) -> surface loop state (HFTASK-0020) + delivery result (HFTASK-0021) back in chat. Lower priority - handoff is the process middle (R12); this is the human-facing half.
acceptance_criteria: RuVocal front-door chat UI (human surface, adopt-and-extend): implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
